contract_blocks.original_text:
- name: quickbooks__general_ledger
      description: Unified general ledger combining bill, journal entry, and payment double-entry records enriched with account attributes, signed amounts, and running balances
      grain: One row per unique_id (double-entry line item)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__bill_double_entry
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__journal_entry_double_entry
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__payment_double_entry
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__account_classifications
      business_logic: '- Union all rows from intermediate.int_quickbooks__bill_double_entry, intermediate.int_quickbooks__journal_entry_double_entry, and intermediate.int_quickbooks__payment_double_entry; duplicates are preserved. - From the union, select: transaction_id, source_relation, index, transaction_date, customer_id, vendor_id, amount, converted_amount, account_id, class_id, department_id, transaction_type, transaction_source, created_at, updated_at. - Left join intermediate.int_quickbooks__account_classifications on (account_id, source_relation) to enrich account fields; if no match, account_* fields are NULL. - Compute unique_id by building a pipe-delimited string from transaction_id, source_relation, index, account_id, transaction_type, transaction_source in that exact order; treat NULL components as empty strings; hash this string with MD5 to produce a lowercase hex identifier. - Compute adjusted_amount: if account_transaction_type equals transaction_type, use amount; otherwise use amount multiplied by -1; if amount is NULL, adjusted_amount is NULL; when either type is NULL, treat as a mismatch and negate. - Compute adjusted_converted_amount the same way using converted_amount from the union (converted_amount itself is not included in the final output); NULLs propagate. - Compute running_balance as a cumulative sum of adjusted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition, ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id with rows unbounded preceding. - Compute running_converted_balance similarly using adjusted_converted_amount with the same partitioning and ordering. - Window ties on all ordering keys are engine-defined; cumulative sums skip NULL values and return NULL only when the entire frame is NULL. - Output one row per double-entry line enriched with account fields, signed amounts, and running balances.'
      columns:
      - name: unique_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lowercase MD5 of the pipe-delimited string built from transaction_id, source_relation, index, account_id, transaction_type, transaction_source in that order; NULL inputs are treated as empty strings.
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction identifier from the unioned double-entry models; preserved as-is.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Originating model for the entry (bill, journal_entry, payment); used in the account join and in window partitioning and ordering.
      - name: transaction_index
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Line index within the source transaction (from 'index'); preserved as-is.
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Transaction posting date from source; used in window ordering.
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier associated with the transaction when applicable; may be NULL.
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor identifier associated with the transaction when applicable; may be NULL.
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Raw amount from source used to compute adjusted_amount; may be NULL.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from source; used to join classifications and to partition running balances.
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class identifier from source; used to partition running balances; may be NULL.
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department identifier from source; preserved as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number from classifications; NULL if no account match.
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from classifications; NULL if no account match.
      - name: is_sub_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if the account is a sub-account per classifications; NULL if no account match.
      - name: parent_account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent account number from classifications; NULL if none or no match.
      - name: parent_account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent account name from classifications; NULL if none or no match.
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High-level account type from classifications (e.g., Asset, Liability); NULL if no match.
      - name: account_sub_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-type within the account_type from classifications; NULL if no match.
      - name: financial_statement_helper
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Helper label from classifications indicating financial statement grouping; NULL if no match.
      - name: account_current_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Current account balance from classifications; NULL if no match.
      - name: account_class
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Classification label from classifications; NULL if no match.
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Entry type from source (e.g., Debit/Credit or analogous); determines adjusted_amount sign.
      - name: transaction_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source subtype label from the unioned models; included in unique_id but not used in window partitioning.
      - name: account_transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account-side transaction type from classifications; compared to transaction_type to set amount sign; may be NULL.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Row creation timestamp from source; preserved as-is.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Row update timestamp from source; preserved as-is.
      - name: adjusted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: 'Signed amount: equals amount when account_transaction_type equals transaction_type; otherwise amount multiplied by -1; NULL if amount is NULL.'
      - name: adjusted_converted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: 'Signed converted amount derived from source converted_amount: equals converted_amount when types match, otherwise negated; NULL if converted_amount is NULL.'
      - name: running_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Cumulative sum of adjusted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id; NULLs are skipped.
      - name: running_converted_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Cumulative sum of adjusted_converted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id; NULLs are skipped.

- name: int_workday__organization_metrics
      description: Organizational health and efficiency metrics aggregated for active Workday organizations
      grain: One row per (organization_id, source_relation) for active organizations (is_inactive = false)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_workday__organization
      - staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization
      - staging.stg_workday__position
      - staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family_job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family_job_family_group
      - staging.stg_workday__job_family_group
      business_logic: 'Build the base set from organizations marked active. Derive current employee distribution from worker-position-organization joined to position and job profile, restricted to current assignments (no end date): count distinct workers and positions; count distinct current workers by employee type (Regular, Contingent, Intern); compute average and total weekly hours treating missing weekly hours as 40 before aggregation; count distinct current workers by management level (Manager, Senior Manager, Director, Individual Contributor). Derive mobility from all assignments (historical and current), grouped by organization and source: new_hires_last_year counts distinct workers whose assignment started in the past year; departures_last_year counts distinct workers whose assignment ended in the past year; internal_transfers_in counts distinct workers who started in the past year and had any earlier assignment in a different organization within the same source; internal_transfers_out counts distinct workers who ended in the past year and had any later assignment in a different organization within the same source; avg_tenure_days averages days between start and end (or start and today if still active). Derive compensation distribution from current assignments: count distinct compensation grades, job families, and job family groups; most_common_grade is the most frequent compensation grade with ties resolved to the smallest grade ID; count distinct current workers whose job requires shift work or is union eligible. Left join all aggregates to the active organizations and apply defaults: counts to 0, most_common_grade to ''Unknown'', avg_weekly_hours to 40 if no current positions, total_weekly_hours to 0. Compute metrics: organization_health_score (0–100) is 0 when there are no current employees; otherwise sum five 20-point checks capped at 100: has employees; turnover (departures_last_year/current employees) below 20%; management share (managers/current employees) between 10% and 30% inclusive; at least two job families; average tenure at least 365 days. Compute ratios rounded to two decimals: position_fill_rate is current employees divided by total positions times 100 when positions exist, else 0; annual_turnover_rate is departures_last_year divided by current employees times 100 when employees exist, else 0; management_ratio is managers divided by current employees times 100 when employees exist, else 0. Classify performance by health score: ≥80 High Performance, ≥60 Good Performance, ≥40 Average Performance, ≥20 Below Average, else Needs Attention. Classify size by current employee count: 0 Empty, ≤10 Small Team, ≤50 Medium Team, ≤200 Large Team, else Enterprise Unit. Set data_quality_flag with precedence: ERROR if employee count is negative; else WARNING if employees exceed positions, or turnover rate >100%, or management ratio >50%; else VALID.'

contract_blocks.original_text:
- name: workday__employee_overview
      description: 360-degree employee overview combining worker, lifecycle, career, organization, and compensation context with derived scores, risk/value segments, data-quality flag, and analysis timestamp
      grain: One row per (worker_id, source_relation, position_id, position_start_date)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_workday__worker_employee_enhanced
      - intermediate.int_workday__employee_lifecycle
      - intermediate.int_workday__career_progression
      - intermediate.int_workday__organization_metrics
      - staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization
      - staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__job_profile
      business_logic: '- Build employee_base_enhanced from intermediate.int_workday__worker_employee_enhanced (ebe): - employee_id is an MD5 of "<worker_id>-<source_relation>-<position_id>-<position_start_date>" using "-" as delimiter and replacing NULL components with "_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_". - Retain all ebe columns for downstream logic. - Lifecycle metrics (elm) from intermediate.int_workday__employee_lifecycle: select retention indicators, churn risk, maturity segment, departure category, tenure_years, hire cohorts (quarter, year, month, season), retention_stability_score; lifecycle data quality is selected but not used later. - Career metrics (cdc) from intermediate.int_workday__career_progression: - Group by worker_id, source_relation, position_id. - Numeric totals take the largest recorded value in the group; career_development_score is the mean. - Categorical fields (career_stability_category, career_growth_pace, career_phase) choose the most frequent value; when tied, pick the alphabetically earliest. - Also derive the most frequent data_quality_flag (unused downstream). - Organization context (oc): - Join worker_position_organization to organization_metrics on organization_id and source_relation; keep only current relationships (effective_end is NULL). - Retain organization details and department KPIs (size, health, turnover, management ratio, performance, size category). - Join to ebe on worker_id and source_relation so the current organization applies across that worker’s positions. - Compensation/benefits (cb): - Join ebe to position_job_profile by position_id and source_relation, then to job_profile by job_profile_id and source_relation. - Read compensation_grade_id and classify compensation_tier by the first sequence of digits found in the grade id converted to a number: missing/non-numeric → ''Ungraded''; ≤5 → ''Entry Level''; ≤10 → ''Mid Level''; ≤15 → ''Senior Level''; >15 → ''Executive Level''. - work_conditions_score is the sum of three components (0–3): shift required → 0 else 1; union eligible → 1 else 0; default_weekly_hours ≤40 → 1 else 0; NULLs follow the else branch. - Build the comprehensive profile by left joining ebe to elm (worker_id, source_relation), cdc (worker_id, source_relation, position_id), oc (worker_id, source_relation), and cb (worker_id, source_relation, position_id). Compute: - age from date_of_birth relative to current_date with birthday adjustment; NULL when date_of_birth is NULL. - tenure_group from days_as_worker: <365 ''< 1 year''; <730 ''1-2 years''; <1825 ''2-5 years''; <3650 ''5-10 years''; else ''10+ years'' (NULL falls to else). - Default NULLs using these rules: - Lifecycle: retained_30_days/90_days/1_year/3_years → 0; churn_risk_category → ''Unknown''; employee_maturity_segment → ''Unknown''; departure_category → ''Active Employee''; tenure_years → 0; hire_quarter_cohort → ''Unknown''; hire_year_cohort → calendar year of hire_date; retention_stability_score → 0; hire_month → month number of hire_date; hire_season → ''Unknown''. - Career: total_positions_held → 1; total_promotions/demotions/lateral_moves/fast_promotions/management_positions_held → 0; highest_management_level_reached → 1; career_stability_category → ''Unknown''; career_growth_pace → ''Stable Career''; career_development_score → 0; career_phase → ''Unknown''. - Organization: organization_id/name/type/sub_type → ''Unknown''; dept_size → 0; dept_health_score → 0; dept_turnover_rate → 0; dept_management_ratio → 0; dept_performance_category → ''Unknown''; dept_size_category → ''Unknown''. - Compensation: compensation_grade_id → ''Ungraded''; compensation_tier → ''Ungraded''; - name: workday__position_overview
      description: Position-level overview with occupancy history, organizational context, compensation/job profile attributes, current-employee metrics, and derived scores/flags
      grain: One row per position_id and source_relation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_workday__position
      - staging.stg_workday__worker_position
      - staging.stg_workday__position_organization
      - staging.stg_workday__organization
      - intermediate.int_workday__organization_metrics
      - staging.stg_workday__position_job_profile
      - staging.stg_workday__job_profile

      business_logic: '- Base: Start from positions. Compute position_age_days as the days from effective_start to today. Bucket position_age_category by age: <90 days "New Position (<3 months)"; <365 days "Recent Position (3-12 months)"; <2 years "Established Position (1-2 years)"; <5 years "Mature Position (2-5 years)"; otherwise "Legacy Position (5+ years)". - Utilization history: Join worker-position assignments by position and source. Count distinct workers ever assigned (total), with open end date (current), and with closed end date (former). Set position_occupancy_status to "Occupied" if current>0; else "Vacant (Previously Occupied)" if total>0; else "Vacant (Never Occupied)". Average tenure days uses assignment start-to-end when ended, or start-to-today when still open. Take the most recent assignment start as last_assignment_date and most recent end as last_departure_date. New assignments last year count distinct workers with assignment start within the past 12 months; departures last year count distinct workers with assignment end within the past 12 months. - Organizational context: Link positions to organizations and organization metrics. Also link to job profile. similar_positions_in_department is the count of positions sharing the same organization_id and job_profile_id across the dataset. - Compensation and job profile: Derive compensation_tier from the first number found in compensation_grade_id: missing or not numeric → "Ungraded"; ≤5 → "Entry Level"; ≤10 → "Mid Level"; ≤15 → "Senior Level"; >15 → "Executive Level". challenging_work_conditions_score is the sum of three indicators (shift required, union eligible, weekly hours>40), range 0–3. Map management_level to a numeric scale: Director 4, Senior Manager 3, Manager 2, Individual Contributor 1, otherwise 0. - Current employee metrics: From employee overview by position and source. Averages (overall performance, career development, retention stability) are computed only for currently employed workers. Risk counts (High/Medium/Low Risk) are distinct worker counts by risk level without restricting to current employment. Value segments (High Value - High Retention, High Value - Flight Risk) are distinct worker counts by segment. New and veteran counts include only currently employed workers with maturity containing "New Hire" or "Veteran". Average age and ethnic diversity use only currently employed workers; military_veterans_count counts currently employed workers with military service. - Final projection and defaults: If any numeric metric is missing, default to 0; booleans default to false; text dimensions default to "Unknown"; compensation grade/tier default to "Ungraded". last_assignment_date falls back to position_created_date when no assignments; last_departure_date remains null when none. - Rounding: avg_tenure_years_in_position is average tenure days divided by 365, rounded to two decimals. Average employee scores are rounded to two decimals. Average employee age is rounded to one decimal. position_turnover_rate and position_efficiency_score are rounded to two decimals. - Derived metrics: position_turnover_rate is 0 if total ever assigned is 0; otherwise departures in the last year divided by total ever assigned, expressed as a percentage. position_efficiency_score (0–100) is the sum of: 25 if occupied; a tenure bucket (25 if tenure≥2 years, 20 if ≥1 year, 15 if ≥180 days, else 10); up to 30 points from employee performance (performance score × 0.3, capped at 30); up to 20 points from department health (health score × 0.2, capped at 20); then rounded. - Categorization rules (first-match wins): position_performance_category: Vacant Position; High-Performance Stable Position (performance≥80 and tenure≥2 years); High-Performance Position (performance≥70); Stable Position (tenure≥2 years); High-Turnover Position (departures_last_year>1); else Standard Position. management_priority: Review Position Necessity (vacant and age>180 days); Focus on Retention (any high risk employees); Performance Improvement Needed (performance<50); Department Support Needed (department health<50); Maintain Excellence (performance≥80); else Standard Management. cost_performance_analysis: No Current Cost (vacant); High Cost - Low Performance (weekly hours>40 and performance<60); High Cost - High Performance (weekly hours>40 and performance≥80); Optimal Cost-Performance (weekly hours≤40 and performance≥80); else Standard Cost-Performance. strategic_recommendation: Consider Position Elimination (vacant and age>365 days); Consider Position Consolidation (similar positions>5); Develop Succession Plan (any flight risk employees); Consider Position Expansion (performance≥90); else Maintain Current Structure. - Data quality: Mark as ERROR when title is missing/blank, weekly hours≤0, or position_age_days<0; mark as WARNING when weekly hours>80 or current assignments>3; otherwise VALID. - Output ordering: Sort rows by current_workers_assigned descending, then average employee performance descending, then position_age_days descending. - Analysis timestamp: Set to the current timestamp at query execution (time zone aware).'
      columns:
      - name: position_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique position identifier; primary key with source_relation; exactly one output row per (position_id, source_relation)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier associated with the position_id
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: business_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Business title from position source; may be NULL/empty and is validated in data_quality_flag
      - name: employee_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Employee type as stored on the position record
      - name: default_weekly_hours
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Default scheduled weekly hours from position; used in cost and work-conditions scoring; may be <=0 or >80 (flagged in data_quality_flag)
      - name: position_created_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Position effective_start date from the source, treated as the created date
      - name: position_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between effective_start and today; can be negative for future-dated positions
      - name: position_age_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Age bucket based on position_age_days: <90 New; <365 Recent; <730 Established; <1825 Mature; else Legacy'
      - name: total_workers_ever_assigned
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct worker count ever assigned to the position; defaults to 0 when no history
        tests:
        - total_workers_ever_assigned >= 0
      - name: current_workers_assigned
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct worker count with an open assignment (no end date); defaults to 0
        tests:
        - current_workers_assigned >= 0
      - name: former_workers_assigned
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct worker count with a closed assignment (has end date); defaults to 0
        tests:
        - former_workers_assigned >= 0
      - name: position_occupancy_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Occupied if current_workers_assigned>0; else Vacant (Previously Occupied) if total>0; else Vacant (Never Occupied); defaults to 'Unknown' if missing
      - name: avg_tenure_years_in_position
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average tenure in years based on assignment days/365, rounded to 2 decimals; open assignments use today; defaults to 0.00
        tests:
        - avg_tenure_years_in_position >= 0
      - name: last_assignment_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Most recent assignment start date; falls back to position_created_date when none
      - name: last_departure_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Most recent assignment end date; NULL when none
      - name: new_assignments_last_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct worker count with assignment start within the past 12 months; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - new_assignments_last_year >= 0
      - name: departures_last_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct worker count with assignment end within the past 12 months; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - departures_last_year >= 0
      - name: position_turnover_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If total_workers_ever_assigned=0 then 0; otherwise departures_last_year divided by total_workers_ever_assigned as a percentage, rounded to 2 decimals
        tests:
        - position_turnover_rate >= 0
      - name: organization_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization identifier for the position; defaults to 'Unknown' when absent
      - name: organization_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization name; defaults to 'Unknown' when absent
      - name: organization_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization type; defaults to 'Unknown' when absent
      - name: organization_sub_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization sub-type; defaults to 'Unknown' when absent
      - name: staffing_model
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization staffing model; defaults to 'Unknown' when absent
      - name: department_total_employees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Current employee count for the organization from org metrics; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - department_total_employees >= 0
      - name: department_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Organization health score (0–100) from org metrics; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - department_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: department_turnover_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Annual turnover rate from org metrics; defaults to 0.0
        tests:
        - department_turnover_rate >= 0
      - name: department_performance_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization performance category from org metrics; defaults to 'Unknown'
      - name: department_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization size category from org metrics; defaults to 'Unknown'
      - name: similar_positions_in_department
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of positions with the same organization_id and job_profile_id across the dataset; defaults to 0
        tests:
        - similar_positions_in_department >= 0
      - name: job_profile_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job profile identifier linked to the position; defaults to 'Unknown'
      - name: job_profile_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job profile title; defaults to 'Unknown'
      - name: management_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Management level from job profile; defaults to 'Unknown'
      - name: compensation_grade_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Compensation grade identifier from job profile; defaults to 'Ungraded'
      - name: compensation_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier derived from compensation_grade_id digits: Entry ≤5; Mid ≤10; Senior ≤15; Executive >15; ''Ungraded'' when NULL or not numeric'
      - name: is_work_shift_required

        description: True if work shift is required per job profile; defaults to false when NULL
      - name: is_union_eligible

      - name: challenging_work_conditions_score

        tests:

      - name: avg_career_development_score

- name: greenhouse__application_history
      description: Application status-change intervals enriched with candidate/job attributes and per-interval activity counts
      grain: One row per application_id per status-change interval (valid_from→valid_until)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__application_history
      - mart.greenhouse__application_enhanced
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__job_stage
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__activity
      business_logic: '- Build status-change intervals from staging.stg_greenhouse__application_history: - For each application_id, order records by updated_at ascending. - Set valid_from to updated_at of the record. - Set valid_until to the next updated_at for the same application_id; if none, use the current timestamp at query time. - Intervals are half-open: include valid_from, exclude valid_until. - Enrich each interval: - Inner join mart.greenhouse__application_enhanced on application_id to add candidate and job attributes. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__job_stage on new_stage_id = job_stage_id to add the stage name; if no match, the name is NULL. - Compute days_in_stage as the exact seconds between valid_until and valid_from divided by 86,400; fractional days with no rounding. - Count activities per interval: - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__activity on candidate_id only; counts include all activities for the candidate across applications. - For each interval, count activity rows where created_at (as a timestamp) is on or after valid_from and before valid_until. - Duplicates are counted; rows with NULL created_at do not count; if a candidate has no matching activities, the count is 0. - One row is produced per application_id per interval with all selected attributes; the last open interval is time-variant because valid_until uses the current timestamp.'
      columns:
      - name: application_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Application identifier; multiple intervals may exist per application_id
      - name: new_stage_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Stage identifier assigned at this change
      - name: new_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status recorded at this change
      - name: valid_from
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Inclusive lower bound of the interval; equals updated_at of the change
      - name: valid_until
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Exclusive upper bound; next updated_at for the same application_id or the current timestamp if none
      - name: new_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stage name joined by new_stage_id; may be NULL if not matched
      - name: full_name

        description: Candidate full name
      - name: current_status

- name: greenhouse__job_enhanced
      description: Enhanced job facts with applications, interviews, ratings, conversion rates, and time-derived fields per job
      grain: One row per job_id; if multiple distinct hiring team combinations exist for a job_id, one row per distinct combination
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__job_info
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__hiring_team
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__application_info
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__interview_scorecard
      business_logic: '- Start with all jobs from intermediate.int_greenhouse__job_info (job_id, name, status, requisition_id, created_at, departments, offices). - Build hiring_teams from intermediate.int_greenhouse__hiring_team by selecting job_id, hiring_managers, recruiters, sourcers and removing exact duplicate rows; if a job has multiple distinct combinations, all persist and create multiple output rows. - Build application_stats by job_id from intermediate.int_greenhouse__application_info: - Total applications: number of application rows. - Active applications: rows where status equals ''active''. - Hired applications: rows where status equals ''hired''. - Rejected applications: rows where status equals ''rejected''. - Prospect applications: rows where prospect equals the string ''True''. Notes: all comparisons are exact, case-sensitive. - Build interview_stats by joining interview scorecards to applications on application_id and aggregating by job_id: - Total interviews: number of scorecards for the job. - Completed interviews: scorecards where status equals ''completed''. - Average interviews per application: total scorecards divided by the count of distinct applications that have at least one scorecard; returns NULL if there are none. - Average job rating: mean of mapped recommendations (definitely_not→1, no→2, yes→3, strong_yes→4); other values and NULLs are excluded. - Rated applications count: number of scorecards with a non-NULL recommendation (counts scorecards, not distinct applications). - Rating completion rate: constant 1.0 for jobs with at least one scorecard. - Create the final set by left joining jobs to hiring_teams, application_stats, and interview_stats on job_id: - Pass through job and hiring team fields. - Replace NULLs in all count fields with 0; keep averages and rating_completion_rate as returned (they will be NULL when no scorecards exist for the job). - Conversion rates (percent, 0–100, no rounding): - Application to interview: if total applications > 0, total interviews divided by total applications times 100; otherwise 0. - Interview to hire: if total interviews > 0, hired applications divided by total interviews times 100; otherwise 0. - Overall conversion: if total applications > 0, hired applications divided by total applications times 100; otherwise 0. - Time fields: created_year and created_month from created_at; days_since_created is the number of days between the current date and created_at and may be fractional.'
      columns:
      - name: job_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique job identifier; determines row granularity
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job name from job_info

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job status from job_info

        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Requisition identifier; may be NULL

        description: Offices from job_info

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Hiring managers from hiring_team; NULL if no team row

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recruiters from hiring_team; NULL if no team row
      - name: sourcers
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sourcers from hiring_team; NULL if no team row
      - name: count_total_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total applications for the job; NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_active_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Applications with status='active'; NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_hired_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Applications with status='hired'; NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_rejected_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Applications with status='rejected'; NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_prospect_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Applications where prospect equals 'True' (case-sensitive); NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_total_interviews
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of interview scorecards for the job; NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_completed_interviews
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Scorecards with status='completed'; NULL replaced with 0

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total scorecards divided by distinct applications with a scorecard; NULL if none; no rounding
      - name: avg_job_rating

        description: Average mapped recommendation (definitely_not=1, no=2, yes=3, strong_yes=4); excludes other values and NULLs; NULL if none
      - name: count_rated_applications

null when no close_day records • opportunities_won_amount: sum of amounts for status Won rounded to 0 decimals; zero when there are close_day records but none Won; null when no close_day records • opportunities_lost: number of opportunities with status Lost; zero when there are close_day records but none Lost; null when no close_day records • opportunities_lost_amount: sum of amounts for status Lost rounded to 0 decimals; null when there are close_day records but none Lost; null when no close_day records • pipeline_amount: sum of amounts for status Pipeline rounded to 0 decimals; null when there are close_day records but none Pipeline; null when no close_day records - Output: left join each aggregate to the date spine on date_day;       business_logic: '- Create user_performance from intermediate.int_salesforce__user_performance and user_dimension from marts.dim_salesforce__user. - From marts.salesforce__revenue_analytics, aggregate per owner_id: total revenue won (sum of won_revenue), deals won (count of rows where won), average sales cycle (average days on won deals), current-quarter won revenue (sum where in current quarter), previous-quarter won revenue (sum where in previous quarter), and current-quarter deals won (count of won deals in current quarter). - Join user_dimension to user_performance on user_id (left join), and to revenue_data on user_id = owner_id (left join). Keep only rows where the user is active, then group by: • team_manager_id = manager_id with nulls replaced by "No Manager" • team_manager_name = manager_name with nulls replaced by "No Manager" • team_type = user_type (can be null) - For each group, compute: • team_size = distinct count of users • active_team_members = distinct count of users where active (equals team_size under the active-user filter) • high_performers, good_performers, developing_performers, new_users = distinct user counts by performance_tier exact match • team_total_opportunities and team_won_opportunities = sums across users • team_total_revenue and team_total_pipeline = sums of revenue and pipeline amounts • team_win_rate_percentage = 100 × (total won opportunities ÷ total opportunities), rounded to two decimals; return 0 if total opportunities is zero or null • avg_opportunities_per_member and avg_wins_per_member = per-user averages, rounded to one decimal; nulls excluded • avg_revenue_per_member = per-user average revenue won, rounded to the nearest whole unit; nulls excluded • avg_win_rate_per_member = per-user average win rate percentage, rounded to two decimals; nulls excluded • team_total_leads and team_converted_leads = sums across users • team_lead_conversion_rate = 100 × (converted leads ÷ total leads), rounded to two decimals; return 0 if total leads is zero or null • team_total_activities = sum across users; avg_activity_completion_rate = per-user average completion rate percentage, rounded to two decimals; nulls excluded • team_revenue_current_quarter and team_deals_current_quarter = sums of current-quarter revenue and deals from revenue_data • revenue_growth_qoq_percentage = 100 × (current-quarter revenue minus previous-quarter revenue) ÷ previous-quarter revenue, rounded to two decimals; null if previous-quarter revenue is zero or null • team_activities_per_win_ratio = total activities ÷ total won opportunities, rounded to two decimals; null unless both totals are greater than zero • top_revenue_performer = the full_name of the member with the highest total won amount; members without a value are ranked last; ties are arbitrary • top_win_rate_performer = the full_name of the member with the highest win rate percentage; members without a value are ranked last; ties are arbitrary • avg_team_tenure_days = average user tenure in days, rounded to the nearest whole day; nulls excluded • new_team_members and veteran_team_members = distinct user counts where user_tenure_category is "New User" or "Veteran" - Enhance with: • team_performance_tier: - High Performing Team: win rate ≥ 30, average revenue per member ≥ 100,000, and at least 2 high performers - Good Performing Team: win rate ≥ 20, average revenue per member ≥ 50,000, and high + good performers cover at least half of the team - Developing Team: win rate ≥ 10 and average revenue per member ≥ 25,000 - Otherwise: Needs Improvement • team_health_score = sum of five components, clipped to the 0–100 range: - Win rate contribution: the win rate capped at 25 - High-performer share: 25 if high performers ÷ team_size ≥ 0.3, else 15 if ≥ 0.1, else 5 (when team_size is 0, this defaults to 5) - Activity completion: 20 if ≥ 80%, else 15 if ≥ 60%, else 10 - Revenue growth: 20 if > 10%, else 15 if > 0%, else 10 if ≥ -10%, else 5 - Lead conversion: 10 if ≥ 20%, else 7 if ≥ 10%, else 3 • team_diversity_level: - High Diversity: team_size ≥ 5 and at least one high, one good, and one developing performer - Medium Diversity: team_size ≥ 3 and at least one high or good performer and at least one developing performer - Low Diversity: team_size ≥ 2 - Otherwise: Single Member - Output all fields from the enhanced dataset; final ordering is by team_health_score descending, then team_total_revenue descending.'

- name: int_klaviyo__events
      description: Events enriched with inherited touch attribution, joined dimensions, session features, and non-negative revenue fields
      grain: One row per (source_relation, event_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__campaign
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__flow
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__person
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__metric
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_klaviyo__event and derive direct touch fields: touch_id is campaign_id when present, otherwise flow_id; touch_type is ''campaign'' or ''flow'' accordingly. - For events with event_attribution and no direct touch_id, inherit touch from the attributed child: - Remove "$" characters from event_attribution. - Extract the child event id by first looking for relationships.attributed-event.data.id, else attributed_event_id. - Remove surrounding quotes and treat empty values as NULL. - Join back to the events set on source_relation and the extracted child event_id to obtain the child''s touch_id and touch_type. - Set last_touch_id and session_touch_type to the child''s values when found; otherwise use the event’s direct touch_id and touch_type. - Derive occurred_on by truncating occurred_at to the calendar day (date type). - For each person, prev_event_at is the timestamp of the immediately prior event ordered by occurred_at; when none exists it is NULL; ties on identical timestamps follow engine-defined order. - Session features: - inter_event_minutes is the rounded difference in minutes between prev_event_at and occurred_at; NULL when prev_event_at is NULL. - session_seq is a running count per person that starts at 1 and increases by 1 when prev_event_at is NULL or the gap between events exceeds 30 minutes. - Join dimensions with LEFT JOINs scoped by source_relation: - Campaign: only when the effective touch type (session_touch_type if present else touch_type) is ''campaign''; match on the resolved touch id (last_touch_id if present else touch_id). - Flow: only when the effective touch type is ''flow''; match on the resolved touch id (last_touch_id if present else touch_id). - Person: join on person_id. - Metric: join on metric_id. - If a key is not applicable or no match is found, the related dimension fields are NULL. - Derived flags and normalized revenue: - is_engagement_event = 1 when type is one of {''active on site'',''viewed product'',''opened email'',''clicked email'',''received email''} ignoring case; else 0. - amount_positive = numeric_value when type is ''placed order'' or ''ordered product'' (case-insensitive) and numeric_value is non-negative; otherwise 0. - amount_negative = numeric_value when type is ''refunded order'' or ''cancelled order'' (case-insensitive) and numeric_value is non-negative; otherwise 0.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier used to scope joins and grain
      - name: event_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event identifier unique within source_relation; one output row per (source_relation, event_id)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: person_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person identifier for the event; used for window partitioning and person dimension join
      - name: metric_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Metric identifier for the event; used to join metric dimension fields
      - name: type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event type; used to derive flags via case-insensitive matching to specific values
      - name: UUID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event UUID when provided; may be NULL
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Variant or variation identifier when present; may be NULL
      - name: numeric_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Numeric amount parsed from event properties; used for revenue normalization; may be NULL
      - name: event_attribution
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Raw JSON attribution string used to inherit touch from an attributed child; may be NULL
      - name: occurred_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Event timestamp; used for date derivation, window lag, and session segmentation
      - name: occurred_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date derived from occurred_at by truncating to the day; NULL only if occurred_at is NULL
      - name: touch_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Direct touch identifier from the event: campaign_id if present else flow_id; NULL if neither exists'
